projects.title: NoBrainr
projects.description: NoBrainr was inspired by the idea of allowing students to buy and sell textbooks amongst eachother, without the hassle of bookstore lines, expensive prices, and horrible buy-back rates. With our simple to use dashboard, we aim to create a meeting point where students can come to sell textbooks at a reasonable rate and buy them at a better price than the University Bookstore.

projects.title: The Dean's List Project
projects.description: The Dean's List, Inc. is a multi media company devoted to college life. Our first project is a calendar that recognizes 12 beautiful and intelligent James Madison University women. Each woman has selected a charity that is deeply important to her, and we will donate 25% of our profits directly to these charities. Welcome to The Dean's List, and the Class of 2015.
